quote: We introduce rationale extraction for alleged violation prediction in ECtHR cases, a more tractable task compared to legal judgment prediction. This is a multi-label classification task that requires paragraph-level rationales, unlike previous work on word-level rationales for binary classification.
outputs: Paragraph-level rationales justifying model predictions in legal text classification
